prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-19, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-19):
| Return 3m            | +16.2% |
| Return 1m            | -6.1% |
| Return 1w            | -1.5% |
| Range position (63d) | 61% |
| 21d realized vol     | 23% |
| Last close           | 114.20 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows solid medium-term momentum with a +16.2% return over 3 months, suggesting continued strength despite a recent 1-month pullback. A 21-day realized vol of 23% indicates meaningful trading interest and potential for further moves, while a 61% range position signals the price is within its typical range rather than at an extreme. Taken together, the setup favors continued upside over roughly the next 20 trading days.

DECISION: BUY
